description: The bar chart illustrates the proportion of incorrectly answered samples, expressed as a percentage, where the popularity rank of the retrieved knowledge (RPop_Ge) is less than the ground truth popularity rank (RPop_GT), across three different domains—Movies, Songs, and Basketball—for three language models: Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow). The vertical axis represents the ratio in percentage, ranging from 50% to 90%, with horizontal gridlines at 50%, 60%, 70%, 80%, and 90%. In the Movies domain, Llama3 and Qwen2 both achieve high performance with ratios of approximately 90%, while ChatGPT shows a lower ratio of about 73%. In the Songs domain, Llama3 and Qwen2 again perform similarly, with ratios of approximately 84% and 90% respectively, and ChatGPT's ratio is around 63%. In the Basketball domain, Llama3 has a ratio of about 67%, Qwen2 has a ratio of about 57%, and ChatGPT has a ratio of approximately 62%. The chart shows that Llama3 and Qwen2 consistently outperform ChatGPT in the Movies and Songs domains, while the performance gap narrows in the Basketball domain. The bars are grouped by domain, with each group containing three bars representing the three models, and the models are identified by a legend at the top of the chart.
